sql:
SELECT
    d.CalendarQuarterLabel AS quarter,
    count() AS customers_first_purchase
FROM
(
    SELECT
        CustomerKey,
        min(DateKey) AS first_purchase_date
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
    GROUP BY CustomerKey
    HAVING toYear(first_purchase_date) = 2007
) fp
INNER JOIN retail.DimDate d
    ON d.DateKey = fp.first_purchase_date
GROUP BY d.CalendarQuarterLabel, toQuarter(fp.first_purchase_date)
ORDER BY toQuarter(fp.first_purchase_date)
